_comment: Generated by tools/build_manifest.py. All paths are relative to assets/. Rects are [x, y, w, h] in sheet pixels; anchors are [x, y] inside the rect/frame.
recommended_scale: Use 64x32 iso tiles at 1x (all environment art here is drawn for 64x32). LPC characters are 64x64 frames at 1x (~50px tall people), which matches Theme Hospital proportions on a 64x32 grid. Render with imageSmoothingEnabled = false and integer zoom.

characters_lpc.projection: 3/4 top-down ('RPG Maker' / LPC view), 4 directions - works as-is in an iso game (use row by heading)
characters_lpc.anchor_note: feet touch y~60 inside the 64x64 frame (shadow layer centred at ~(32,58)); place anchor on the character's tile position

body_heights_px.adult: ~48-52 px from feet to top of head

idle.frames: breathing; for characters whose clothes lack idle art the composer repeats walk col 0 (static)

cast.frames: LPC spellcast: arms raised and lowered (dance / cheer / fight); children: synthesised hop in place

hurt.frames: LPC hurt, facing the camera only: crumples and falls; last frame = lying (slip / sleep / pass out); children: synthesised topple

sit.frames: 3 sitting poses (cols 0-2); outfits whose dress/jacket/skirt has no sit art use a plain top/skirt of the same colour; none for children

characters_lpc.index_js: characters/index.js defines window.CHAR_INDEX (paths relative to index.html, groups, guest pools m/f/om/of/kb/kg) - the game should load that
characters_lpc.iso_direction_mapping: iso screen-diagonal headings: NE->row 0 (up) or 3, NW->row 0 or 1, SE->row 2 or 3, SW->row 2 or 1; simplest: pick by sign of screen dx (left/right rows) when |dx| > |dy|, else up/down rows
characters_lpc.layers_dir: vendor/lpc-characters/spritesheets (same 64x64 grid; walk / idle / sit / spellcast / hurt .png, or <anim>/<colour>.png)
characters_lpc.compose_tool: tools/lpc_cast.py (cast definition) -> tools/lpc_characters.json -> tools/lpc_compose.py tools/lpc_characters.json -> tools/lpc_index.py (index.js + previews/cast_*.png)  (catalog: tools/lpc_layers.json, colours: vendor/lpc-characters/palette_definitions + tools/lpc_palettes_custom.json)

environment_hawkbirdtree.contains: beds, wardrobes, round tables with table cloths (peach/light blue/lilac/wood), long tables (white cloth!), wooden chairs (2 facings), stools, barrels, crates, market stall with awning, L-shaped counter, chests, clocks, vases incl. flowers, potted tree, curtains, banners, rugs and long runner carpets (aisle!), brick/stone walls, wooden/tiled floors, grass/sand/water floor tiles
environment_hawkbirdtree.layout: packed sheet: furniture sits roughly on 64x64 cells (5 cols x 10 rows) but sizes vary, so use the rects; floors are 64x32 diamonds; walls are 64x64 cells
environment_hawkbirdtree.anchor_convention: anchor = foot point inside the sprite rect (approximate centre of the footprint). For objects that fill a whole tile (tables, beds) put the anchor on the tile centre; small props: tile centre too.

misc_block_curtain_fireplace_well_crates.note: several touching sprites (blue curtain, brick fireplace, stone well with roof, 2 crates); crop by hand

environment_hawkbirdtree.wall_placement: A wall cell shows the two BACK walls of one tile as a peak: left 32px = wall standing on the tile's NW edge, right 32px = wall on the NE edge; walls are 48px tall. With (tx, ty) = top-left of the tile's 64x32 diamond bbox on screen: NW wall = cell x 0..31 drawn at (tx, ty-48); NE wall = cell x 32..63 at (tx+32, ty-48); SE (front) wall = cell x 0..31 at (tx+32, ty-32); SW (front) wall = cell x 32..63 at (tx, ty-32). Draw back walls before the tile's contents and front walls after. '_dark_top' variants have a darker cap (good for cut-away/low walls).

environment_hawkbirdtree.projection: isometric 2:1 pixel art; ground blocks are 64x64 cubes whose top face is a 64x32 diamond
environment_hawkbirdtree.big_oak_note: the big oak is two parts: draw tree_big_oak_trunk with its top-left at crown.x+58, crown.y+128 (i.e. sheet positions as given), then the crown on top. The other pieces at x 768..1023, y 448..511 are modular crown/trunk bits.
environment_hawkbirdtree.contains: grass blocks (plain, with red/purple/yellow flowers, rocks), dirt/sand path blocks with grass edges, water/cliff/waterfall blocks (cols 4-11, not listed), slopes, flat paving slabs, trees (round green/teal/autumn, big oak, modular trunks), bushes, stumps, fences/rope posts, notice boards, signs, stone columns, crate, barrel, gravestones
environment_hawkbirdtree.layout: x 0..767: 64x64 grid (12 cols x 21 rows) of ground blocks; x 768..1023: objects (use rects)
environment_hawkbirdtree.block_placement: Draw a block cell with its top-left at (tx, ty) where (tx, ty) is the top-left of the tile's 64x32 diamond; draw back-to-front so only top faces show, and the earth sides appear only at the map edge (nice 'diorama' border). Anchor [32,16] = centre of the top face.

props_kenney_pixelized.projection: isometric 2:1 (true iso renders, downscaled ~0.31 so 1 Kenney floor tile = 64x32), 1px dark outline, 12 colours each
props_kenney_pixelized.facing: _SE / _SW = front views (towards camera, right/left); _NE / _NW = back views
props_kenney_pixelized.contains: toilets, sinks, mirror, bin, floor speakers (DJ), small speakers, radio, bar counter + bar end, bar stools, fridge, coffee machine, floor/wall lamps, potted plant, cushioned chairs (4 facings), bench, sofa, rectangular table with cloth, round table, doors (closed/open frame), plain walls / walls with doorway / walls with window (white/grey), rugs, doormat, coat rack, box
props_kenney_pixelized.anchor_convention: anchor ~ bottom-centre of the footprint; tune per sprite in-game

props_lpc_cakes.note: small table-top cake; for a tiered wedding cake stack/scale it or draw one
